record.question: CBDT stands for
record.explanation: Answer A: Central Board of Direct Taxes. CBDT expands to Central Board of Direct Taxes. The Income Tax Department’s own organizational description uses the official name; Centre, Taxation and the singular Tax are not the printed expansion. Historical/source note: Only the stable organizational name is used from this page; its listed individuals are not treated as verified current officeholders. Reference: https://www.incometax.gov.in/iec/foportal/about-us/who-we-are. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
